newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton settles sharply higher, funds buy.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton settles sharply higher, funds buy.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed firmer but slipped slightly off the day's highs on steady producer selling, floor sources said.
Technically-driven fund buying lifted the market out of its previous range capped at 74.00 cents in March, to a high of 74.45 cents.
Support was revised upwards to 73.00 cents from 72.00 cents.
Traders cited early trade buying, which triggered stops at 73.90 cents and higher in March.
March cotton settled 1.10 cent firmer to 74.10 cents, after trading in a range from 74.45 to 73.30 cents. The deferred contracts finished 1.00 to 0.04 cent higher.
Fundamentally, expectations that Thursday's weekly export and sales data will to show robust sales, may have lent support to the market, analysts said.
The U.S. Department of Agriculture will release the report at 0830 EST.
